arguments.content: P1 pattern: replacing an existing client's success-response mock with a future provider's richer receipt can conceal a mixed-version regression. When client and provider ship independently, verify the client against the supported provider snapshot and check both persisted state and caller-visible success: the provider can commit the update while a new mandatory acknowledgement check makes the client report failure. Keep a regression case with the released response shape alongside receipt-aware cases; gate mandatory receipts on established support.
